name: Mysterious meteorite
what_i_did: A craggy dark spheroid (Voronoi-cell plates, flat facets) split into a base bowl and five hinged petals, each leaning a few degrees out so star cracks of the glowing core show. A cyan core inside and four clusters of hexagonal crystals breaking through. In the game it sits 60% exposed in its own fresh crater, pulses once every 2 s, lights the crater cyan, and can open like origami (petals swing out over 6 s).
good: Reads as the sheet: dark stone, cyan crystals, glow from inside the cracks.
The only #00ffd1 on the tile, so a child's eye goes straight to it.
States built in: buried, glowing, opening, open (life.meteorite.open()).
off: Game size is 0.56 m across, not the story's 20-25 cm, so it reads from the tile camera (toy scale).
The sheet's pale weathered top plates are only hinted (a lighter rock material on upward faces).
No violet-blue highlights yet; the MeteorVein material exists for them.

rounds.t: First build: too spiky, zig-zag seam at the base read as a grin.
Softer cells, base seam closed, petals ajar on their hinges instead, crystals pushed out through the shell.
